encounter.title: Act I Encounter 4 — Square Candidate B (7x7 seed 11)
encounter.notes: LD-004 candidate B for Act I #4. 7x7 seed 11 (12 arrows: N4 E5 S0 W3). Pattern: BOTTLENECK on a spacious 7x7 dais. Arrow #0(W) hits on turn 1, then #1(N) unblocks #4(W) and #6(W). On turn 3, Stone Throw pins East arrow #3 safely, allowing #4(W) and #6(W) to cleanly eliminate the Thrower. Clean sequence: #0(W) -> #1(N) -> #4(W) -> #6(W) (4 taps, 0 damage). Tapping non-essential arrows results in taking 2 damage on turn 4.
